scenarios.scenario: Switch customization targets by keyboard with an edit pending

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target
the Part Manage target is empty
the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in the available list
the user opens the custom panel target selector
the user presses Down and Enter to select Part Manage
the Part Manage custom panel list is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
Apply and cancels are enabled
the user opens the custom panel target selector
the user presses Up and Enter to select Part Tools
the Part Tools target has a pending-change marker
"2D Sketches" appears in the custom panel list
the user clicks Cancel
the customization dialog closes
no User Commands panel is visible on the Tools ribbon

scenarios.scenario: Reopen customization after choosing another target without editing

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
the Part | Tools and Part | Manage custom targets are empty
the user opens Customize from Tools
the ribbon customization target is "Part | Tools"
the user selects "Part | Manage" as the target
the user closes customization without editing any commands
the user opens Customize from Tools again
the ribbon customization target is "Part | Tools"
the target command list is empty
the user closes customization
the Tools ribbon remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Reopen customization after choosing a command source without editing

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Tools ribbon tab is selected
the Part | Tools custom target is empty
the user opens Customize from Tools
the command source is "All Commands"
the user selects "View Tab" as the command source
the available command list shows View Tab commands
the user closes customization without editing any commands
the user opens Customize from Tools again
the command source is "All Commands"
the Part | Tools custom target remains empty
the user closes customization
the Tools ribbon remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Open customization from the View ribbon context menu

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the View ribbon tab is selected
the Part | View custom target is empty
the user opens the context menu on the Windows panel title
the user chooses Customize User Commands
the ribbon customization dialog opens
the target is "Part | View"
the command source is "All Commands"
the target command list is empty
the user closes customization
the View ribbon remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Cancel a staged command on the View ribbon target

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the View ribbon tab is selected
the Part | View custom target is empty
the user opens Customize User Commands from the Windows panel context menu
the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in All Commands
"2D Sketches" appears in the Part | View target
the target is marked as changed
the user cancels customization
the user reopens Customize User Commands from the Windows panel context menu
the Part | View target is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in All Commands
the user closes customization
the View ribbon remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Add a selected command using the keyboard transfer button

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
ribbon customization is open with "All Commands" selected
the Part | Tools custom target is empty
the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available commands list
the user presses Enter while the list has focus
"2D Sketches" remains selected in the available commands list
the Part | Tools target remains empty
Apply remains disabled
the user presses Tab and then Space
"2D Sketches" appears in the Part | Tools target
the target is marked as changed
Apply and cancels are enabled
the user cancels customization
the customization dialog closes

scenarios.scenario: Retain staged command display options when switching targets

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
ribbon customization is open with "All Commands" selected
the Part | Tools and Part | Manage custom targets are empty
the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Part | Tools target without applying
the user checks Large and Text for that command
the user selects the Part | Manage target
the Part | Manage target list is empty
"2D Sketches" is available in the source list
the user returns to the Part | Tools target
"2D Sketches" remains in the target list
its Large and Text options are checked
the target is marked as changed
Apply and cancels are enabled
the user cancels customization
the customization dialog closes
